items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only reacts to the interviewer's statement mentioning Bruce ('I’ll be damned.') and does not claim any personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: The other half of the book was in two cardboard boxes, when Boyd in the late 50s had been evicted from a loft in New York, and he had given these two card board boxes full of manuscript paper, full of charts to this guy in Long Island for safe keeping and there it stayed until about 1979. And Bill Schremp tracked it down and Bruce and this guy in Long Island both shipped the music to Washington D.C…
